Package backend.service

Class BookingService

java.lang.Object
backend.service.BookingService
public class BookingService extends Object
Service class for managing bookings and pickup/return records. This class provides methods to interact with the bookingDAO and PickupReturnDAO for performing CRUD operations on bookings and pickup/return records.

    • createBooking

      public boolean createBooking(int userId, int carId, LocalDate pickupDate, LocalDate returnDate, double totalAmount)
      Creates a new booking with the specified details and inserts it into the database.
      Parameters:
      userId - The ID of the user creating the booking.
      carId - The ID of the car to be booked.
      pickupDate - The date when the car will be picked up.
      returnDate - The date when the car will be returned.
      totalAmount - The total amount for the booking.
      Returns:
      true if the booking was successfully created, false otherwise.
